summary.request: We sell through the web shop and through field sales, and sales prices for an item must be able to differ per sales channel. A price list line without a channel applies to every channel. The order taker picks the channel on each sales order line and the price must follow when the channel changes. The sales line must also show the price agreement number of the price list line that set its price. Pricing staff maintain these prices in the price worksheet.
summary.business-process: Make sales prices on price list lines depend on a sales channel picked on each sales order line, and show the applied line's price agreement number on the sales line; this extends the standard price list calculation (Sales Line - Price, Price Calculation - V16) and price worksheet maintenance.

knowledge.used-for: Overall decision map for the pricing rule and the new-experience requirement
constraints: Keep the rule in price list data plus events of the standard calculation; do not compute prices in OnUpdateUnitPriceOnBeforeFindPrice with IsHandled.
A pricing extension built on price lists must state that it requires the new pricing experience.
Whether a new rule should outrank existing prices is a business decision; raise it as a question.

knowledge.used-for: Channel as a price list line attribute: buffer field, blank-fallback filter, duplicate key, recalculation
constraints: Add the field to Price List Line, Price Worksheet Line (same number), Price Calculation Buffer and Sales Line.
Fill the buffer in OnAfterFillBuffer of each line type in scope.
Filter in OnAfterSetFilters with SetFilter(Field, '%1|%2', Value, ''), never SetRange.
A specific line wins over a cheaper generic one only if OnAfterIsImprovedLine/OnAfterIsDegradedLine say so.
Add the attribute to the duplicate filters in OnAfterSetAssetFilters of Price List Management.
Do not model the attribute as a new price source.

knowledge.used-for: Carrying Price Agreement No. from the applied price list line to the sales line
constraints: Copy in OnAfterSetPrice of Sales Line - Price, the only event that receives the applied line.
Copy only for AmountType Price; check the price type because resource lines also run a Purchase calculation.
Clear the value when IsRealLine() is false (fallback price).
Do not look the price list line up again in OnAfterApplyPrice/OnAfterUpdateUnitPrice.
Give the field a twin with the same number on Price Worksheet Line.

knowledge.used-for: How the standard calculation selects a line and which events change it
constraints: Change the result through events of the calculation and leave selection to it.
Levels decide before amounts; within a level the cheapest line wins.
Tests call EnableExtendedPriceCalculation of Library - Price Calculation because the feature key decides the engine.

knowledge.used-for: Keeping both fields through the price worksheet, Copy Lines and Suggest Lines
constraints: Every custom Price List Line field needs a twin on Price Worksheet Line with the same number, name and type, shown on the worksheet page.
Copy Lines keeps custom fields by record assignment; Suggest Lines never fills them.
Implement worksheet lines through ImplementNewPrices, not by writing Price List Line.

knowledge.used-for: Building active price lists in tests and the duplicate check on activation
constraints: Create lines through CopyFrom(PriceListHeader) and activate with Validate(Status, Active) on the header, never by assigning Status.
Library - Price Calculation builds headers and lines the same way.

knowledge.used-for: Recalculating the price when the channel changes on an existing line
constraints: Call SalesLine.UpdateUnitPrice(FieldNo(<field>)) from the field's validation; UpdateUnitPriceByField alone recalculates nothing unless the field was planned.

knowledge.used-for: Keeping the rule to sales and guarding purchase calculations
constraints: Subscribe to the Line With Price codeunit of each document in scope; sales, purchase and project use different price types, sources and amount fields.
Sales Line - Price also runs with the Purchase price type for resource unit costs.

knowledge.used-for: Deciding which posting stages the two sales line fields reach and the pages that show them
constraints: Plan one step per stage the field must reach, the page extensions that show it, and a test that posts and reads the value back from every target.

constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on every TransferFields target the plan needs; keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables; no subscriber needed.

knowledge.used-for: Decisions for the new Sales Channel entity: table type, privacy, pages, permissions

constraints: Supplemental table: primary key Code[10] named Code, one List page with plural name set as LookupPageID.

open-questions.question: Within one price level the cheapest line wins, so a cheaper generic line beats a channel-specific one. Must a channel-specific line always win over a cheaper generic line? If yes, add OnAfterIsImprovedLine and OnAfterIsDegradedLine subscribers on Price Calculation - V16 and a test where the generic line is cheaper.
Are sales channels user-maintained records (Sales Channel table, as designed) or a fixed list (enum)? Should installation create the web shop and field sales channels?
The channel filter applies to every sales amount type, so line discounts on price lists can also be channel-specific. Is that wanted, or must the filter apply to prices only?

The design mirrors Sales Channel Code and Price Agreement No. on Sales Shipment Line, Sales Invoice Line, Sales Cr.Memo Line, Return Receipt Line and Sales Line Archive so the values survive posting and archiving. Are any of these not needed, should the posted line pages show the fields, and must the values also reach Item Ledger Entry or Cust. Ledger Entry?

When Copy Document recalculates lines (Include Header off, or copying a posted shipment or return receipt), custom line fields are not copied. Must Sales Channel Code survive a document copy (subscriber to OnAfterRecalculateSalesLine of Copy Document Mgt.)?

Restoring an archived order revalidates the lines and reruns the price calculation. Should the restored line keep the archived Price Agreement No., or the one of the price list line that applies at restore time?
Suggest Lines in the price list and worksheet builds lines without a channel (generic). Should it ever set a channel or an agreement number on suggested lines?
The request names sales order lines. Should the channel also be entered on quotes, blanket orders, invoices, return orders and credit memos, and should it default from the header or the customer?
Is Price Agreement No. a free code typed by pricing staff (Code[20] as designed) or a reference to an agreement record or number series?
Should Sales Channel Code be blocked or hidden on purchase and project price list lines, where it has no effect?
Which Business Central version does the app target? From BC24 table-field tooltips are inherited by page fields; earlier targets need page-level tooltips.
